posts.zh:
dsh-mcp-view 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。MCP 服务器与工具清单面板：侧边栏一键悬浮面板，按服务器分组展示全部 MCP 工具（传输方式、端点、JSON Schema、最近使用时间），默认折叠、支持搜索与实时刷新；最近使用时间来自真实会话日志。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ee453d4ca6edf0e9dc6b.html
posts.en:
dsh-mcp-view is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. MCP servers & tools inventory panel: one-click floating panel from the sidebar that lists every MCP server and tool (transport, endpoint, JSON schema, last-used time), grouped by server, collapsed by default, with live search and refresh; last-used times come from real session logs.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ee453d4ca6edf0e9dc6b.html
